use: Style evidence only; never copy phrases, facts, numbers or identity.
method: Roster weights normalized over available eligible donors; equal mass per donor post; sentence mass equal within post. UTC cadence over observed scrape interval. Signature lift is weighted cluster document frequency divided by unweighted eligible all-donor document frequency (3-word EN / 4-character ZH n-grams, present in at least 2 cluster posts).

first_lines.text: Micron's mobile business is on a tear. Its gross profit per smartphone up 15x y/y in 3QF26. 87% gross margin in 3QF26 vs 24% a year ago quarter. Mobile revenue up 3.5x while gross profit up nearly 13x. How sustainable is this and how low units can go? https://t.co/fJkdpo5vyM
What stocks could win big from the shift to AI inference?
Nebius $NBIS is outperforming CoreWeave $CRWV by nearly 8X in 2026, despite CoreWeave generating 5X more revenue – so, what gives? Clearly something is happening beyond the income statement.
8 ATH quarters last 9. Insane demand. Leading-edge at full utilization rate. https://t.co/b1k0bC3kVC
2027 EUV orders fully covered.  For 2028, has already received substantial EUV orders. https://t.co/CfpYrmp8Xa
2nm capacity growth of 70% between 2026 and 2028 is now bigger. Same for N3 numbers (bigger than what they showed at recent conference).
TSMC Apr 2026

Intel 14A progressing well. 0.9 version of 14A PDK for external customers in Oct and internal customer earlier. Risk production in 2028 and mass production in 2029 (in line with TSMC timing). Driving roadmap to 10A.7A nodes to make customers sticky. Has recognised the importance of IPs to expand into mobile. Internal EDA spent consolidated.
NVIDIA QApr26

Top-5 WFE companies' cumulative China revenue down -18% q/q and up 5% y/y. 3rd consecutive quarter of y/y growth. All five companies are guiding to 20-30% China share for 2026, down from 30-44% peaks in 2024-25. AMAT back to #1 spot but Lam stand out, only vendor with 4 consecutive y/y growth quarters, accelerating to +36% in 1Q. Non-China trends are strong with leading-edge logic, HBM/DRAM and advanced packaging investments.

CXMT 1Q26 revenue alone is almost equivalent to its whole 2025 revenue. Operating at 95%+ fab utilization rate. For context, CXMT's 1Q26 revenue is greater than Micron's DRAM revenue just 3 quarters ago but less than half of Micron's current quarter DRAM revenue. https://t.co/V6JlXQFcde

Qualcomm's elusive search for growth driver coming to an end. Custom silicon revenue kicks from 2HC26 and sees 'very material' revenue in '27. Broadcom and Marvell target competition. Layering on top of this, CPU and AI accelerator which will roll out from '27 and beyond. QCOM is ready to take lower GM to get into the DC space but sees OPM accretive opportunities. Wouldn't be surprised if QCOM's DC revenue overtakes handset revenue in a few years time if they follow-up with a strong roadmap. QCOM is also working with hyperscalers on personal intelligence devices, a well suited effort.

🟠NAND systems revenue dollars more than doubled q/q to 23% of systems (up from 12%); Lam’s SAM per wafer expected to double from 128L to 500L+ devices  🟠DRAM flattish q/q at record dollars (23% of systems). Expanding share in traditional DRAM via tech transitions; Akara etch momentum
🟠CSBG (Services record $2.5B (+17% q/q, +43% y/y), 3rd consecutive record. Driven by record upgrades
